entities.name: Reito
entities.description: City in the Towabara Plains near Eiganjo Castle on Kamigawa, name meaning ghost city.

entities.name: Reito Massacre
entities.description: Kami attack that destroyed Reito, considered the start of the Kami War.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War of the kami against mortals.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: Man whose tampering with the spirit world led to the attack.

entities.name: Horobi
entities.description: Kami born from the ashes of Reito.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: City that has been built over the former site of Reito.

events.summary: After Takeshi Konda's tampering, the kami set upon Reito, killing nearly every living thing in the Reito Massacre, the start of the Kami War.
events.quote: This event, known as the Reito Massacre , is considered the beginning of the Kami War .

events.summary: The kami crush the militia; from the ashes of Reito the kami Horobi is born.
events.quote: From the ashes of Reito, was born the kami Horobi .

relations.note: His tampering led to the kami attack
relations.quote: After Takeshi Konda 's tampering with the spirit world, the kami set upon the city.
